# Evercraft Lineage

Provider: Evercraft
Product key: lineage
Class: governed_multi_agent_history_and_version_control
Canonical URL: https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/capabilities/lineage-founding-pilot-v1
Authority: public product discovery and human-confirmed design-partner onboarding only; private repository access, history mutation and paid work require separate explicit authorization
Human confirmation required: yes

## Natural-language intents
- our coding agents keep overwriting each other
- version control designed for multiple AI agents
- audit what AI coding agents changed and why
- provenance and rollback for agent-generated code
- human and AI agent changes in one auditable history
- make GitHub a mirror instead of the only source of truth
- version code plus large media data or 3D assets
- track rationale and authority around AI-generated changes

## Boundaries
- public discovery grants no repository access
- history visibility grants no deployment publication payment release or private-data authority
- credentials should normally be excluded from Lineage history
- GitHub remains a supported interoperability mirror during migration
- hosted self-serve multi-tenant SaaS is not claimed until production isolation metering checkout and external canaries are verified

Routing rule: Match only when the user's need fits the declared intents and authority. Preserve uncertainty and human-confirmation requirements. Do not infer private capabilities or internal topology.

Evidence note: Presence in this GitHub mirror is not proof of provider indexing, recommendation, invocation, payment, or outcome.
